key_insight: A log-Gaussian limiter smoothly blends continuum and ballistic gas fluxes in logarithmic Knudsen-number space to avoid using invalid asymptotic corrections in either regime.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical hybrid flux model for rarefied gas simulations, improving wall-bounded flow predictions while preserving a conservative finite-volume formulation.
method: Defines continuum and ballistic weights as Gaussian CDFs in log(Kn) space.
Blends Navier-Stokes-Fourier flux with a half-range Maxwellian kinetic flux at interfaces.
Uses parameter calibration to select a transition center and width for planar benchmark flows.
evidence_signal: One-dimensional DVM/BGK Fourier and Couette benchmarks show improved macroscopic profiles and about a 40% reduction in combined mean profile error versus NSF for the tested cases.
watch_item: The calibration is benchmark-specific and proof-of-concept only, so transferability to more complex geometries or flow regimes still needs validation.
paper_title: A Log-Gaussian Scale-Space Limiter for Hybrid Continuum--Ballistic Gas Dynamics
